faqs.question: Will a website redesign hurt my existing Google search rankings?
faqs.answer: Not when done professionally. We conduct an exhaustive URL audit of your existing website and build a comprehensive 1-to-1 301 redirect map. By matching legacy URLs with improved, faster pages, our redesigns frequently increase search visibility rather than damaging it.

faqs.question: How do I know if my website actually needs a redesign?
faqs.answer: Common warning signs include: mobile visitors bouncing rapidly, taking longer than 2.5 seconds to load, inability to easily update copy yourself, looking dated compared to competitors, or failing to generate consistent phone calls and email enquiries.

faqs.question: Can we keep our existing content and case studies?
faqs.answer: Yes. We safely migrate your existing articles, case studies, client reviews, and photography into the modern design layout, updating heading structures and image formats for optimal performance.

faqs.question: How long will our website be offline during the redesign?
faqs.answer: Zero minutes. We build and test your new website completely on a private staging server. Your existing website remains fully live and operational until the exact moment we point DNS to the new build.
